kill_criteria.measurement: BUBR1 abundance by immunoblot in patient cells versus untreated, at or below labelled exposure
Mitotic timing and micronucleus rate in the same cells in which abundance rose
kill_criteria.threshold: less than 20% improvement versus untreated despite higher abundance

kill_criteria.measurement: Intracellular NAD+ in patient cells at a concentration achievable with labelled dosing
Viability and proliferation of treated versus untreated cells
kill_criteria.threshold: more than 10% loss of viable cells or any cell-cycle arrest voids an aneuploidy-lowering result

confounds: Fewer divisions or cytostasis produce a lower aneuploidy rate without any rescue
Aneuploid daughter cells die and are lost from the count, leaving survivors that look corrected
Test concentrations above clinical exposure create a result that cannot translate
Higher BUBR1 abundance without a checkpoint readout is not functional rescue

weakest_link.claim: The mapped drug acts on BUBR1 abundance or function in this patient's cell type
weakest_link.why: No curated source tests either drug on BUBR1 in cells; the bridge rests on other genes, other diseases or non-drug experiments.

experiment_zero: Measure BUBR1 protein abundance by immunoblot in the patient's own cells against controls before any drug; if abundance is normal, drop the abundance-restoration hypothesis.
